fields.description: Specifies type of creator with one of the following: ‘person’, ‘group’, ‘institution’, or ‘position’. If this attribute is not specified, the creator is assumed to be a person.

fields.description: Brand of the overall device that houses single or multiple instruments/components. For example, ***REMOVED***Hohonu***REMOVED*** is the brand of a sensor that can contain multiple instruments.

fields.label: Instrument
fields.description: Global, vocabulary-constrained attribute indicating the name of the contributing instrument(s) or sensor(s) used to create this dataset. Indicate controlled vocabulary used in the instrument_vocabulary attribute. Separate multiple instruments using commas.

fields.label: Instrument component
fields.description: The value of a component applies to the like-named field in the IOOS SOS Asset Identifier URN; it is used to identify individual, distinct components, or sub-assets (for example, two different sensor types), on a single platform. The :component is mapped to the Asset Identifier as follows:   Asset Identifier = urn:ioos:asset_type:authority:label[:component][:discriminant][#functional_parameters]  See examples below.

pages.label: Tidal Datum Offsets relative to station

fields.label: Enter known tidal datum offsets relative to the station datum.
MHHW (m):
fields.description: Offset between station datum and MHHW in meters

fields.label: MHW (m):
fields.description: Offset between station datum and MHW in meters

fields.label: DTL (m):
fields.description: The arithmetic mean of mean higher high water and mean lower low water.

fields.label: MTL (m):
fields.description: The arithmetic mean of mean high water and mean low water.

fields.label: MSL (m):
fields.description: The arithmetic mean of hourly heights observed over the National Tidal Datum Epoch. Shorter series are specified in the name; e.g. monthly mean sea level and yearly mean sea level.

fields.label: MLW (m):
fields.description: Offset between station datum and MLW in meters.

fields.label: MLLW (m):
fields.description: Offset between station datum and MLLW in meters

fields.label: GT (m)
fields.description: The difference in height between mean higher high water and mean lower low water.

fields.label: MN (m)
fields.description: The difference in height between mean high water and mean low water.

fields.label: DHQ (m)
fields.description: One-half the average difference between the two high waters of each tidal day observed over the National Tidal Datum Epoch. It is obtained by subtracting the mean of all the high waters from the mean of the higher high waters.

fields.label: DLQ (m)
fields.description: One-half the average difference between the two low waters of each tidal day observed over the National Tidal Datum Epoch. It is obtained by subtracting the mean of the lower low waters from the mean of all the low waters.

fields.label: HWI (hr)
fields.description: The average interval (in hours) between the moon***REMOVED***s transit over the Greenwich meridian and the following high water at a location.

fields.label: LWI (hr)
fields.description: The average interval (in hours) between the moon***REMOVED***s transit over the Greenwich meridian and the following low water at a location.
